description: One row per training run (results/*.parquet). Config columns come from stein/train.py DEFAULTS; metric columns from stein/train.py:evaluate. List-valued fields are JSON strings.

config.arm: shapes/cifar: none, vicreg, sigreg, sksd, ksd, mmd, ema, oracle; temporal: ema, ema+sksd, ema+sigreg, sksd, vicreg (also sigreg, none); vae: betavae, ksd, mmd
config.d: embedding dimension (dimensional bottleneck); content dimension k = 6 on 3DShapes
config.sigma: information bottleneck: z + sigma * std_batch(z).detach() * N(0,1) on the predictor/decoder input
config.alpha: nuisance strength: 3DShapes = prob. each nuisance factor is resampled in view 2 (clips: prob. of a +-1 step per frame); CIFAR = augmentation strength
config.law: 3DShapes content sampling law over object hue and scale: uniform | gaussian | laplace
config.prior: target law of KSD/sliced KSD/MMD (and of the ksd_prior / npksd metrics): gaussian | uniform (GN p=8 score surrogate) | laplace (tanh-smoothed score)
config.seed: training seed (tuning seeds and held-out seeds are disjoint)
config.num_slices: sliced KSD directions per step (SIGReg uses 256 via lejepa)
config.T: temporal tier clip length (context = first T-1 frames, target = last frame)
config.noise: pixel noise sd (view noise eps) on training views
config.device, threads: not part of the run hash
config.sigreg_impl, pred_norm: implementation switches kept for the pilot record

metrics.content_r2: linear (ridge) probe R^2 of content code [cos h, sin h, scale, simplex(shape)] from frozen embeddings, fit on train-split images, evaluated on held-out test-split images; mean over 6 targets (3DShapes tiers)
metrics.content_knn_r2: kNN (k=10) regression R^2 of the content code (information regardless of linear access)
metrics.leak_r2: nuisance leakage: linear probe R^2 of [cos fh, sin fh, cos wh, sin wh, orientation] (3DShapes) or of the 8 augmentation parameters (CIFAR); lower is better
metrics.shape_acc: logistic-regression accuracy for the categorical shape factor
metrics.class_acc: CIFAR-10 logistic-regression class accuracy on un-augmented test images
metrics.ident_orth_r2: R^2 of the best scaled semi-orthogonal map from centred embeddings to standardised content code
metrics.eff_rank: RankMe effective rank of held-out embeddings (meaningless when emb_std_mean ~ 0, i.e. collapse)
metrics.emb_std_mean: mean per-dimension sd of held-out embeddings (collapse indicator)
metrics.gauss_ep_raw: sliced Epps-Pulley statistic / N vs N(0, I) on raw embeddings (256 slices)
metrics.gauss_ep_std: same on per-slice standardised projections (shape only)
metrics.ksd_prior: IMQ KSD^2 U-statistic of 1000 held-out embeddings to the run's prior
metrics.npksd_prior, npksd_p: NP-KSD statistic and simulated-null p-value (30 null draws; min p = 1/31)
metrics.loss_final, pred_final, reg_final: means over the last 20% of steps
metrics.loss_cv_last20: loss stability: sd/mean of total loss over the last 20% of steps
metrics.loss_nonfinite: number of steps with a non-finite loss
metrics.train_time_s, eval_time_s: wall clock (concurrent workers share the GPU)

files.tuning.parquet: P2 tuning runs (seeds 100, 101), one row per run; columns = config + metrics above. Grid: stein.grids.tune
files.tuning_selected.json: selected level per tuning slot (stein.select_tuning); criterion = mean validation content_r2 (CIFAR class_acc)
files.tuning_table.md: all tuning levels with scores and the chosen one
files.heldout.parquet: P2 held-out runs (seeds 1-5), one row per run; grid stein.grids.heldout (slices H1, H4, H2, H3, H5, CIFAR, H6)
files.lam_sens.parquet: P2 robustness slice: all 3 tuning levels of vicreg/sigreg/sksd/ksd/mmd/oracle at the base setting, held-out seeds 1-5 (stein.grids.lam_sens)
files.summary.parquet: one row per held-out config: KEYS (tier, arm, d, sigma, alpha, law, prior, lam, ema_tau), n_seeds, collapsed_frac (share of seeds with emb_std_mean < 0.01), and for each metric m: m (mean over seeds), m_lo, m_hi (95% percentile bootstrap CI over seeds, 10000 resamples)
files.tuning_summary.parquet, lam_sens_summary: same layout as summary.parquet for the tuning runs and the lambda-sensitivity slice
files.contrasts.parquet: one row per hypothesis contrast: hyp, label, metric, est (difference of means), lo, hi (95% bootstrap CI, seeds resampled independently per group; H4 interactions are differences in differences), sign (+/− CI excludes 0, 0 includes 0, n/a missing)
files.pilot_*.parquet, validation.json: P1 pilot and validation outputs (seed 0; not results)
